question: **The impression one forms of the gentlemen is that they:**
solution:
The correct answer is: **were cruel and uncaring**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The last part of the given passage confirms that the gentlemen were not good-hearted people.
 
• Its states that
 
 
• As a result, they imposed the rule that all impoverished individuals must starve gradually at home.
 
• A com-factory was asked to provide modest amounts of oatmeal, and the waterworks were asked to provide an endless supply of water.
 
• It was also planned to serve three meals of thin gruel each day, with an onion twice a week, and half a loaf of bread on Sundays.
 
 
 
• From the above points, we can say that the impression one forms of the gentlemen is that they were cruel and uncaring.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**
